Bug_Title: Locks should be released on all paths
Bug_Explanation: The lock is acquired at the beginning of the showBug method but is only released if isInitialized() returns true, leading to a situation where the lock may not be released if isInitialized() returns false.
Trigger_Explanation: The test cases call the 'showBug' method on an instance of 'LockExample'. The first test case sets the 'initialized' flag to false and calls 'showBug', which doesn't release the lock because 'isInitialized' returns false. The second test case sets the 'initialized' flag to true and calls 'showBug', which releases the lock. Both tests demonstrate that the lock is not released properly when 'isInitialized' is false.
